best_hook.why: Overhead shot of a woman in bed with a bare-chested priest and the line 'A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him': instant forbidden-affair scandal.

best_cliffhanger.why: Agnes sees the noblewoman and the priest entwined through the door and her jaw drops; the secret now has a witness and the clip cuts before anyone knows she saw.

must_promos.why: 'Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.' as the hook, the corrupt bargain sealed with seduction and an embrace, then a maid walks in on them and gasps; cut on her horrified face.
Priest-in-bed scandal line, then 'Name your price' and his demand for the whole west territory's taxes, ending on 'Discretion has a price' before she agrees.

standalone_risk: Catherine, Father Thomas and Agnes are side characters and neither lead appears; a stranger does not know what 'the hearing' is or why Agnes witnessing this is dangerous, so the ad sells a scandal but not the show's premise.
notes: The witness beat is only about 5 s at the very end, so any promo ending on it has to start no earlier than about 00:19.
